_about: Layer 2 (product line) and layer 3 (series) of Cisco unified communications hardware, 14 Sep 2026: VG voice gateways, analog telephone adapters, Business Edition 6000 / 7000 appliances, Expressway and VCS appliances, Unity Connection / MCS servers, Atlas paging. IP desk phones filed under UC labels belong to collaboration-endpoints (not this category); their deploy_role still comes from the collaboration-endpoints series table. No role axis of its own.

not_this_category.why: Cisco IP phone filed under a UC software label (Unified Communications Manager)

series.note: MEM-224-* (VG224 DRAM and flash, moved in from routers by run #1074, closing items at aa1143f item 4): a component follows its host

layers round 3, UC round: Cisco's 'Euro-ISDN Media Gateway VG-2BRI' end-of-sale notice names the product; VG-2BRI and VG-2BRI-R sat in the line's shared parts by their label (gateways in shared parts, which the device check names)
MEM-243-* (IAD2430 integrated access device DRAM and flash, moved in from routers by run #1074): the IAD2430 itself is not in the catalogue, so its memory sits with the line's shared parts

lines.no_family_reason: Cisco names the VG200 / VG300 / VG400 series and the VG-2BRI media gateway directly under its VG Series Gateways, with no family between

series.note: layers round 3, UC round: named by Cisco's 'SPA232D Multi-Line DECT ATA and SPA302D Multi-Line DECT Handset' end-of-sale notice; the nine SPA232D rows sat in the line's shared parts by their label (ATAs in shared parts)
layers round 3, UC round: named by Cisco's 'IP Telephony Gateway SPA8000 and SPA8800' end-of-sale notice; the seven rows sat in the line's shared parts by their label (gateways in shared parts)
